title: Solvent-induced a series of dysprosium complexes with different slow relaxation behavior

material_class.structural_family: mononuclear eight-coordinate Dy(III) complex; snub disphenoid J84; hydrogen-bonded 3D supramolecular packing

synthesis.procedure: H2L1 (0.1 mmol, 31 mg) and Dy(CH3COO)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 90 mg) were placed in a 20 mL Teflon reactor, 8 mL CH3CN was added, and the mixture was stirred for 10 minutes and heated at 80 °C for two days. Yellow rod-like crystals of 1 were obtained. Yield 43% based on H2L1.
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow rod-like crystals formed directly from the solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: χMT is 14.10 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 300 K (near the value for one Dy(III)) and falls to 10.64 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 2 K under 1000 Oe, consistent with depopulation of Dy(III) Stark levels and/or weak interactions. M versus H/T curves do not superimpose, indicating magnetic anisotropy. Only a weak out-of-phase ac susceptibility is observed at zero dc field over 9–999 Hz; no clear SMM barrier is reported.

measurements.conditions: zero Oe static field, 9–999 Hz; weak χ'' only

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as for complex 1 using H2L1 (0.1 mmol, 31 mg) and Dy(CH3COO)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 90 mg), except the solvent was changed to CH3CN/DMF (1:1). The mixture was heated at 80 °C for two days, giving yellow rod-like crystals. Yield 39% based on H2L1.

material_class.structural_family: tetranuclear [2×2] square-grid Dy4 cluster; biaugmented trigonal prism or triangular dodecahedron

synthesis.procedure: Prepared as for complex 1 using H2L1 (0.1 mmol, 31 mg) and Dy(CH3COO)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 90 mg), except the solvent was changed to CH3OH. The mixture was heated at 80 °C for two days, giving yellow rod-like crystals. Yield 33% based on H2L1.

reagents.name: methanol
reagents.amount: volume not separately stated; replaces the 8 mL CH3CN used for complex 1

synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: Yellow rod-like crystals formed directly from the solvothermal reaction.

properties.summary: χMT is 56.45 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 300 K (near the value for four Dy(III) ions) and falls to 20.69 cm^3 K mol^-1 at 2 K under 1000 Oe. M versus H/T data indicate significant magnetic anisotropy. Complex 3 shows clear single-molecule magnet behavior under zero dc field; Cole–Cole plots fit a single Debye process (α = 0.04–0.25), with Ueff = 19.3(1) K and τ0 = 2.1(3)×10^-5 s.
